messages:
maria (PM): Quick sync: we need to finalize scope for a customer-driven prefetch + generator integration by EOD Fri. Targets: p99 <250ms for short completions, tenant isolation, and a canary plan.

aj (EngLead): Runtime batching + infra prewarm are the main blockers. Storage eviction semantics might need a schema change.

tess (Runtime): I can add a namespaced prefetch shim. Estimate 0.5 FTE x3 sprints to stabilize and run evals; will need a fallback model variant.

samir (Infra): Ask: reserve 8 GPUs for burst/prewarm and implement autoscale hooks. Provisioning + safety testing ~2w. Will share SKU + cost doc.

olivia (Security): KMS namespaced keys ok, but we must scrub tenant IDs from debug logs and update rotation notes. I'll PR a checklist by Thurs.

jamie (SRE): SLO/runbook: if burst > capacity, route to fallback model and tag responses as "degraded". Need alert thresholds; I'll draft runbook.

maria (PM): Action list: tess -> shim PR, samir -> capacity & cost, olivia -> compliance checklist, jamie -> SLOs/runbook. I'll run a 15-min lockstep Fri 10:00 to finalize. If blockers: DM me.
